item.name: Stripe Post   Invoices Invoice Lines Line Item Id

request.name: Stripe Post   Invoices Invoice Lines Line Item Id

description.content: Updates an invoice’s line item. Some fields, such as tax_amounts, only live on the invoice line item, so they can only be updated through this endpoint. Other fields, such as amount, live on both the invoice item and the invoice line item, so updates on this endpoint will propagate to the invoice item as well. Updating an invoice’s line item is only possible before the invoice is finalized.

urlencoded.description: The integer amount in cents (or local equivalent) of the charge to be applied to the upcoming invoice. If you want to apply a credit to the customer's account, pass a negative amount.
An arbitrary string which you can attach to the invoice item. The description is displayed in the invoice for easy tracking.
